long_biography.plain_text:
Practical vessel experience shaped Claude Racine's approach to brokerage. Before concentrating on sales, he captained, managed, chartered and delivered vessels ranging from 50 to 120 feet, working routes from South Florida to the Great Lakes. That operational background gave him experience across American and international yacht brands.

Racine's sales affiliations have included Mares Yacht Sales, Westport Yacht Sales and Peck Yachts. His brokerage career extends from the 1990s into the present, covering builder representation, new construction and pre-owned transactions. At Peck, he advises clients buying and selling luxury yachts, applying the operational knowledge developed through earlier management and delivery work.
